one_line: Founding Chishti Sufi master of Ajmer, known for teaching, hospitality and service to the poor in 12th–13th century India.

appearance.age_look: Late 50s to early 60s, medium height, slightly stooped yet calm and steady; lean but not frail, with the quiet strength of a lifelong ascetic.
appearance.face: Oval face with a high, thoughtful forehead, medium wheatish complexion from Sistan, gently lined cheeks, straight nose, soft but penetrating dark eyes, neatly trimmed grey beard and moustache, default expression serene and compassionate with a faint, welcoming smile.
appearance.hair: Dark greying hair, kept short and tidy, mostly hidden beneath a simple white cloth turban wrapped low and close to the head, with one narrow end hanging short over the left shoulder; no ornate crest or jewelry on the turban.
appearance.costume: He wears a loose, knee-length off‑white cotton kurta with straight sleeves and a simple round neck, over taupe woolen churidar-style trousers gathered neatly at the ankles; around his shoulders is a plain, slightly worn, light brown wool khirqah‑style cloak, open at the front and tied with a thin cord at the chest, its texture visibly coarse and humble; a soft, undyed cotton shawl with a subtle narrow stripe at the edges in muted indigo is draped from his right shoulder across the torso and over the left forearm; his feet are in simple brown leather sandals with a single strap over the instep; no metal armor or royal insignia, only a small cloth pouch at his waist suggesting travel and charity.
appearance.signature: A modest wooden staff, about as tall as he is, smooth from use with a slightly darker knobbed top, always held lightly in his right hand or resting beside him to signify his wandering Sufi life and guidance.

ref_desc: An older Muinuddin Chishti with an oval wheatish face, short greying hair under a simple white turban, off-white kurta, taupe trousers, light brown wool cloak, muted indigo-edged shawl, brown sandals, and a plain wooden staff in a soft earthy palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Khwaja Muinuddin Chishti: an older, medium-built man with an oval wheatish face, gentle dark eyes, neatly trimmed grey beard, and short greying hair mostly hidden by a simple white cloth turban wrapped close to the head with a small tail over his left shoulder. Dress him in a loose, knee-length off-white cotton kurta, taupe churidar-style trousers, and a plain light brown wool khirqah cloak tied by a thin cord at the chest, with a soft undyed cotton shawl edged in muted indigo stripes draped from his right shoulder across his torso and over his left forearm. Put simple brown leather sandals on his feet and a small cloth pouch at his waist; no royal or military ornaments. He carries a modest wooden staff as tall as he is, with a slightly darker rounded top, held lightly in his right hand. Use an earthy palette of off-white, light brown, taupe, muted indigo and dark brown, and pose him in a calm, welcoming stance suitable for consistent redrawing from multiple angles.
